title: Office work and craftsmanship
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a munkával való elégedettségről, a stresszről és a szakmák megbecsültségéről.

scenes.description: It is eight o'clock in the evening in a large open-plan office. Most of the desks are empty, but a young woman wearing a headset is still staring at two computer screens full of charts. Next to her keyboard there is a half-eaten takeaway salad and a phone showing several missed calls. She looks stressed and is rubbing her neck.

In a small, sunny workshop, a carpenter in his thirties is finishing a wooden chair. Tools are hanging on the wall, and the floor is covered in wood shavings. A teenage apprentice is watching closely as the carpenter shows him how to make the surface smooth. Both of them seem calm and focused, and the carpenter is smiling.

prompts: Compare the two working environments and how the people might feel.
Why do fewer young people choose manual or vocational jobs today?
followUpQuestions: Why do so many office workers suffer from stress and burnout?
Should vocational training be more respected in Hungary? Why?
Should employers limit how much overtime people can do? How?
Would you prefer a well-paid office job or a job where you make things with your hands? Why?

usefulPhrases.en: She appears to be under a lot of stress.
usefulPhrases.hu: Úgy tűnik, nagy stressz alatt van.
